research.summary: Sandalwood and cedar give this composition its woody center. Cardamom, iris and violet sit alongside leathery and musky impressions, with a smoky character in the brand’s description.

wear.text: Scento’s editorial guide suggests autumn, winter and spring, during the day or evening. These are suggested settings, not measured performance.

sources.title: Santal 33 Eau de Parfum: note stages

research.summary: A composition centered on ambroxyde, with jasmine and moss adding contrast. Le Labo describes an animalic musk impression with a bright edge.

wear.text: Scento’s editorial guide suggests autumn, winter and spring, during the day or evening. These are suggested settings, not measured performance.

research.summary: Bright bergamot and fig meet cedar, vetiver and musk. Black tea brings a dry, leafy impression with hay and tobacco associations as the fragrance settles.
A tea accord meets creamy fig, with bitter orange providing contrast. Cedar and vetiver give the composition a soft woody foundation.

wear.text: Le Labo presents it as a scent intended to be noticed close to the wearer.

research.summary: Bergamot and grapefruit give a bright, bitter citrus impression. Petitgrain brings a floral edge, while amber, musk and vetiver add warmth and structure.
A bright bergamot opening meets a woody, ambery Ambroxan character. Dior describes this version as the citrus-led expression of Sauvage, with elemi adding a resinous facet.

wear.text: Dior states 6 to 8 hours on skin. This is the brand’s estimate, not a result measured by Accord.
Dior suggests everyday use and warmer seasons for this version.

research.summary: Bergamot opens into lavender and spices before a vanilla and Ambroxan base. The brand describes a warmer, more enveloping interpretation than the eau de toilette.

wear.text: Dior states 8 to 10 hours on skin. This is a brand claim and individual wear can differ.

sources.title: Sauvage Eau de Parfum product reference
Sauvage Eau de Parfum release reference

research.summary: Mandarin and bergamot meet creamy sandalwood and cedar. Tonka bean and vanilla bring a rounded, warm base to this woody interpretation of Sauvage.

wear.text: Dior describes 8 to 10 hours of wear, with the scent becoming closer to the skin as projection fades.
Dior suggests cooler seasons, evenings and formal settings. These are the brand’s suggestions, not restrictions.

research.summary: Grapefruit and warm spices lead into lavender, followed by rich woods. Licorice, vetiver and patchouli support the ambery base in Dior’s account of the composition.

wear.text: Dior describes a powerful trail from an unusually concentrated composition. No numeric concentration is supplied here.

research.summary: A fresh opening gives way to cedar and sandalwood. Chanel emphasizes the rounded warmth of the woods within this aromatic composition.

entries.name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum

research.summary: Cedar and sandalwood shape an aromatic woody composition, supported by ambery and musky notes. This version emphasizes warmth and depth within the Bleu de Chanel family.

sources.title: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Parfum product reference

entries.name: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Toilette

research.summary: Citrus brightness meets an aromatic accord and dry cedar. Sandalwood brings warmth to the trail of this fresh woody version.

sources.title: Bleu de Chanel Eau de Toilette product reference

research.summary: Jasmine and pink pepper sit within an ambery patchouli composition. White musk and vanilla give this floral fragrance a soft, enveloping quality.

sources.title: Chance Eau De Parfum product reference

research.summary: Bitter almond adds a new facet to the jasmine, gourmand sweetness and ambergris accord. Woody, ambery and musky tones give this extrait its fuller interpretation of Baccarat Rouge 540.

sources.title: Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum product reference

research.summary: Tobacco meets vanilla and tonka bean in a warm, sweet composition. Cocoa, dried fruit and woody impressions add richness to its gourmand character.
Tobacco and vanilla are joined by a whiskey-cask accord and oakwood. Bitter orange adds contrast to the woody character of this parfum interpretation.
An ambery Ambrox character meets black tea and bright citrus. The tea adds a smoky contrast to the composition’s fresh, luminous side.
Bergamot leads into orange blossom, followed by patchouli and musky Ambrofix. The floral heart gives a softer contrast to its warm woody foundation.

wear.text: Yves Saint Laurent describes a lasting woody floral trail, without a measured duration.

research.summary: Bright citrus and blackcurrant leaf introduce pineapple, pink pepper and jasmine. Birch, patchouli and musk add a woody, smoky contrast to the fruit.
Bergamot and mandarin introduce a fresh marine impression. Ginger, pineapple and pink pepper develop over musk, patchouli and birch in Creed’s current description.

wear.text: Creed describes a light trail supported by a smooth musk accord.

research.summary: An abstract floral composition with bright citrus, rose and jasmine, shaped by aldehydes and softened by vanilla. This is Jacques Polge’s eau de parfum interpretation, introduced in 1986.
Leather is the central impression, with cardamom, jasmine and earthy patchouli around it. Amber and moss add warmth to the floral leather composition.
A fresh aromatic fragrance with bergamot, lemon and peppermint, followed by lavender and geranium. Oakmoss and woods ground the green impression.

Rock salt, fig leaf and juniper open onto a floral heart of orange flower, jasmine buds and tuberose. White amber, musks and blonde woods form the base. Moroccanoil presents it as the floral addition to its Signature Collection, inspired by a Mediterranean coastal garden at first light.

research.summary: Prada describes an inverted structure for this ambery woody scent. Bergamot and airy musks lift the top, a rosy geranium forms the heart, and Peru balsam, benzoin and guaiac wood build the ambery woods beneath.

sources.title: Paradigme Eau de Parfum product reference
Tom Holland fronts Prada's new men's fragrance

research.summary: A fruity floral addition to Paradoxe. A blackcurrant syrup accord opens it, orange blossom absolute brightens the heart, and the line's neroli is reworked as a creamy milk accord in the base.

sources.title: Prada Paradoxe Sweet Chemistry new perfume

research.summary: A woody, spicy and musky entry in Les Infusions. A chai latte accord leads into a creamy sandalwood accord over musks, with cardamom and citrus named as bright accents.

Prada launches chai latte scented perfume

research.summary: A fruity floral member of the Chance line. A sparkling raspberry accord with rose and violet facets gives way to rose geranium from Chanel's Grasse fields, finished with powdery iris and a cedar and white musk accord.

sources.title: Chanel's nose Olivier Polge takes another Chance

research.summary: The most concentrated Bleu de Chanel. Sandalwood moves to the front, while cistus labdanum adds a leathery, resinous depth against woody ambery notes. Chanel calls it an intense ambery aromatic fragrance.

research.summary: An amber floral with a gourmand twist. A raspberry mousse accord, orange flower and mandarin open onto a macaron rose accord with vanilla bean and cashmeran, settling into patchouli, amber, sandalwood, cedar and tonka bean.

research.summary: Balmain Beauty's first prestige fragrance, a floral fruity scent. Ripe strawberry opens onto peony with creamy lychee facets and a lily accord, then pink pepper, Akigalawood, sandalwood and patchouli over musky Ambrexolide.

sources.title: Destin de Balmain Eau de Parfum product reference

research.summary: An amber gourmand in the Private Blend line, built on Tom Ford's Cocoa Smoke co-distillation of cocoa and tobacco. Orange essence lifts it, while dark chocolate, Peru balsam, patchouli and Ambrofix add depth.

research.summary: A fougère woody ambery Extradose of Born in Roma Uomo. A spice blend balanced with bergamot and mandarin opens it, with lavandin, an amplified dose of vetiver and guaiac wood for a warm, leathery feel.
